sourceContracts.contract: Searchable grouped provider grid; coding agents separate from agent model sources; two columns; explicit choice before credential setup.
Provider labels, help links, official default endpoints.
Six plan identities, dedicated/default endpoints; Qwen Token Plan permits a user-supplied HTTPS endpoint.
OpenAI uses Responses; Anthropic Messages; Google Gemini; remaining listed vendors use OpenAI Chat Completions.
SDK request factories; explicit Anthropic and Bearer model-discovery headers at247/294.
Runtime plan traffic delegates to its official vendor adapter; quota validation/fallback catalogs are separate behaviors.
Chat traffic resolves root endpoint to /v1; pinned native discovery uses /api/tags, unlike this template.

implementation: 21 actionable choices: Codex, six coding plans, 12 API templates, Ollama, custom endpoint. No inert entries for unsupported coding-agent adapters.
Search, standard keyboard activation, 2-column desktop / 1-column narrow layout, exact template selection and unique instance IDs. No API keys or models copied from existing providers.
Explicit provider editor fetch/test/Save controls remain responsible for actual connection behavior. Card selection makes no network request.

Optional bounded templateId round-trips in existing encrypted provider store; it is display provenance only and never changes endpoint/auth. Old configs have no guessed type. Counts say configured, not verified.
Changing a fixed template route clears its provenance; the pinned configurable Qwen Token Plan keeps its chosen identity for a valid custom HTTPS endpoint.
Picker layers over the operation-lifetime fix: active requests prevent Add, rejected/stale picker callbacks cannot append into another selection, owner deletion and dialog closure retire owned UI.
MainWindow Add and empty-list setup open the picker; Edit carries the exact instance ID and rejects a stale card. Modal parent deletion is guarded.
Provider repository compare-and-swap preserves concurrent changes; settings reload occurs before outcome reporting so errors remain visible.
The custom endpoint card spans the full wide section; ordinary cards remain two-column at512 and one-column at350.
